9:41
settings
Turn-taking
How walkie knows you are done speaking. Both work; they trade privacy against hands-free.
Mode
Hold to talk
The mic opens when your thumb goes down and shuts when it lifts. Cut in by pressing.
Open mic
walkie listens continuously and decides when you stopped. Cut in by speaking.
While open mic is on
Show the indicator always
A live mark in the chrome whenever the mic is open, not only while you speak.
Mute on lock
Close the mic when the phone locks, even mid-session.
Hold to talk is the default because earshot is the authentication boundary, and a closed mic is a much smaller one. Open mic is worth it when your hands are on a keyboard — which is exactly when you would turn it on deliberately.
